messages:
Leah (Infra PM): quick post-allhands question: can we get a clear statement on how the APAC warm-pool will be used during holiday traffic? the slide said 'warm buffer' but not how it interacts with preemptible spillovers. cc @Carlos

Carlos (VP Infra): short version: warm-pool is a regional reserved reserve to keep latency-critical routes inside APAC. spill to preemptible still occurs when warm exhausted, but routing now prefers same-region warm nodes for `tier=premium` routes.

Isha (SRE): nit: we shipped an update to the routing policy last week. new priority order is: regional-warm -> regional-preempt -> remote-warm -> remote-preempt. config key: `routing.priority_sequence`.

Ben (Platform Eng): to add: the console will show a per-route heatmap next week so teams can see warm usage. API tag is `route.metrics.warm_pool_pct`.

Maya (Support): from a customer support POV, what should CS say if a customer sees increased latency because their requests spilled to preemptible nodes? any canned messaging?

Leah (Infra PM): recommend: 1) explain we have regional warm reserved for latency tiers 2) note temporary preemptible spill due to capacity pressure 3) offer to review route config and suggest `min_warm` or upgrade to guaranteed regional capacity add-on. I'll draft an FAQ.

Isha (SRE): ops detail: preemptible detection now tracks `preempt_rate` per-region over 60s windows. we mark region as "volatile" when preempt_rate > 0.2 and automatically increase `min_warm` allocation for premium routes by 1 for 10 minutes.

Ben (Platform Eng): implementation snippet we pushed to staging: 
```
routing:
  priority_sequence: [regional-warm, regional-preempt, remote-warm, remote-preempt]
  preempt_detection:
    window_s: 60
    rate_threshold: 0.2
```

Leah (Infra PM): action items from this thread: 1) Isha to share preempt detection dashboard link 2) Ben to post console heatmap mock screenshots 3) Leah to draft CS FAQ + template message. target EOD Wed.

infra-bot: alert: autoscaler/v2 queued rollout to prod at 2024-03-15T09:12:03Z. monitor: autoscale-latency, warm-pool-util. :robot_face:

Maya (Support): thanks. also can we have a sample single-sentence explanation for customers to reduce handoffs?

Carlos (VP Infra): sample: "During peak regional demand we briefly use lower-cost preemptible capacity to maintain throughput; high-priority routes remain on our regional warm pool for latency guarantees." feel free to tweak.

Isha (SRE): testing note: we have a synthetic test case `tests/holiday/warm-pool-stress` that simulates 3x baseline request rates and toggles preempt spikes. run with `make stress TEST=holiday/warm-pool-stress`

Ben (Platform Eng): billing note: spill events will be annotated with `spill_reason=preempt` in the usage logs; finance will show those under the preempt SKU. expecting a small delta during the holiday window.

Leah (Infra PM): one more leadership note: procurement is lining up an extra rack for APAC to expand warm-pool capacity in Q2; we'll propose a small pilot for 2 enterprise customers to validate SLA and pricing.

Maya (Support): thumbs up on the customer-facing line. I'll hold on messaging until FAQ lands.

Leah (Infra PM): thanks all 4dd I'll collect these notes and send a short follow-up to the all-hands thread. if anyone wants to add runbook items, drop them in #eng-oncall and tag me.

Carlos (VP Infra): thanks team. reminder: if you have an on-call runbook update, include recovery steps for "regional-volatile" state.

Isha (SRE): added runbook PR: infra/runbooks/warm-pool-volatile.md -> staging branch.

Leah (Infra PM): perfect. closing. :white_check_mark:
